name: Kyrgyzstan: the Constitution of 1993 (to 2010) and the Constitution of 2021
label: Kyrgyzstan
record_note: The Constitution of 5 May 1993 in all its editions until it was replaced on 2 July 2010, and the Constitution of 5 May 2021. The Constitution of 2010 (in force 2010-07-02 to 2021-05-05) is not in the record.

dates.time: 12:00 Asia/Bishkek (UTC+5 with summer time UTC+6 in 1991-2005, UTC+6 since 12 August 2005; rules written into the builder)

scope.when_absent: no scope note found; not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: non-retroactivity of laws that impose duties or aggravate liability
default_reach.meaning: a law or other normative legal act that establishes new duties or aggravates liability has no retroactive force
default_reach.authority: Конституция Кыргызской Республики 2021 года, статья 6, часть 5: «Закон или иной нормативный правовой акт, устанавливающий новые обязанности или отягчающий ответственность, обратной силы не имеет.»
